pages.text: Graft a gland onto an organism and press your wrist to it. It fills $(o)you$() with that essence. The first time, it changes you.$(br2)Your body holds a limited pool of each essence, and it only refills at a gland.

Some powers are $(l)passive$(): I switch them on and they burn their pool slowly. Several can run at once. Others are $(l)active$(): I choose one and use it.$(br2)$(l)Density$(): Iron Fists. $(l)Speed$(): Quickening. $(l)Size$(): Shrink or Grow. $(l)Awareness$(): Glowing Sight. $(l)Time$(): Rewind, back to where I stood five seconds ago.$(br2)I steer them with an $(l)Essence Manipulator$().
pages.title: Powers

pages.text: A gland can $(l)swell$(), once I know how (Deeper Infusion, then Deepest Infusion). I feed it a $(l)culture of its own essence$(), and its organism pays: 64 drams for the second level, 96 for the third. Only a big organism can spare that much.$(br2)A swollen gland fills me deeper: my power level for its essence rises to the gland's.
pages.title: A Bigger Gland
